description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the AuthorizationContext interface, including methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and manipulation of authorization subject lists within the context of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableAuthorizationContext
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the AuthorizationContext interface, providing creation, JSON serialization, and list manipulation functionalities for authorization contexts within the project.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of ImmutableAuthorizationContext with specified authorization subjects, either from a list or individual subjects.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an ImmutableAuthorizationContext instance from a given JSON object, parsing its fields accordingly.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the authorization context.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Returns the list of authorization subjects contained in the context.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjectIds
methods.description: Returns a list of IDs of authorization subjects, with caching for performance.

methods.name: getFirstAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Returns the first authorization subject if available.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of authorization subjects.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no authorization subjects.

methods.name: addHead
methods.description: Creates a new context with provided subjects added at the beginning.

methods.name: addTail
methods.description: Creates a new context with provided subjects added at the end.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Determines if the context is authorized based on granted and revoked subject collections.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the context into JSON format with schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: authorizedSubjectsToJson
methods.description: Converts authorization subjects to a JSON array of their IDs.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over authorization subjects.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a stream over authorization subjects.
